features.note: Cmd+N, cascades position (main.rs:81).

features.feature: Close / delete note with unsaved-content confirm
features.apple: MainMenu: File > Close; Localizable: discard-note confirmation
features.note: Delete Sticky Note asks first (alert sheet, Cancel/Delete, Escape cancels) when the note has text, and the delete is undoable. Cmd+W is not bound: the shell keeps it for the window. Built on parity/team-d-stickies; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Cmd+W is owned by the shell's window close; to route it here the shell would need a per-app close hook.

features.note: Plain text, and RTF files (public.rtf) become one note whose bold, italic, underline and strikethrough runs are kept (model.rs:726 runs_from_rtf, from the SDK attributed string reader). Text colours, lists and RTFD images are not imported yet. Built on parity/team-d-stickies; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Map the RTF foreground colours to Ink and keep list markers; RTFD images need the rich note model (see the rich text row).

features.note: Writes .txt named after the note title.

features.apple: MainMenu: File > Export All to Notes…
features.note: Unchanged: no BifrOSt notes-app import control exists to export into. The notes app's intents are reachable from the shell's Services only, not from another app.
features.wire: If an SDK call from one app to another app's intent exists (or a shell routing for it), add an "Export All to Notes" item that posts each note with its colour as folder name; keep the text export as is.

features.note: File > Print... (Cmd+P) sends the focused note as plain text through the SDK print operation and reports the result as a notification. No page setup or print preview; not yet checked on the lab machine.
features.wire: Add a page setup item that uses the SDK print info (ui print.rs PrintInfo) and print preview through the print panel.

features.feature: Undo / Redo of edits and arrange
features.apple: MainMenu: Edit > Undo/Redo; Localizable: Undo/Redo Arrange
features.note: Snapshot undo/redo (history.rs) for typing runs, move/resize, delete, colour, style, collapse, arrange, import, replace, add link and correct spelling; named Edit titles via undo_name (main.rs:148). Caret and selection moves are not steps.
features.wire: Undo of a style change restores the whole board snapshot; a per-range undo would store only the changed runs.

features.apple: MainMenu: Edit > Cut, Copy, Paste, Select All
features.note: Cut, Copy, Paste and Select All act on the selection (Copy without a selection copies the whole note); both Edit menu items and the shell Command route. Paste is plain text: pasted text takes the style before the caret.
features.wire: Carry styled runs on the pasteboard (SDK pasteboard rich types) so a paste keeps bold and italic; Paste and Match Style then drops them.

features.feature: Caret and text selection inside a note
features.note: Caret and selection (byte offsets, TextBuffer) with typing at the caret, click placement, drag selection, double-press word select, arrows, Home/End, Delete. Cmd-Left and Cmd-Right go to the ends of the line, Cmd-Up and Cmd-Down to the ends of the text, and Cmd with Shift extends the selection (chord keys, main.rs:604). Plain Shift+arrow and Option+arrow word jumps are not possible: the shell sends no modifier for plain keys.
features.wire: Shift+arrow and Option+arrow need the shell to send Shift and Alt with plain arrow keys (the proto CHORD flags only cover Ctrl and Cmd chords).

features.feature: Paste and Match Style / Copy Style / Paste Style
features.apple: MainMenu: Edit > Paste and Match Style; Format > Font > Copy/Paste Style
features.note: Copy Style takes the style at the caret (model.rs current_style); Paste Style applies it to the selection, or the whole note, and keeps the note's size (Style::take_attributes). Paste and Match Style is the plain paste, which already takes the style before the caret. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Paste Style from another app's rich text needs the rich pasteboard (see the Cut / Copy row).

features.feature: Find / Replace / Find Next / Use Selection for Find
features.note: Find... (Cmd+F) opens an in-app find bar, searches all notes (ASCII case-insensitive), Cmd+G / Cmd+Shift+G step and select the match, Use Selection for Find (Cmd+E). Replace: Tab in the bar moves to a replace field, Return (or Edit > Replace) replaces the selected match and steps on, Edit > Replace All replaces in every note; one undo step each. Built on parity/team-d-stickies; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add an Ignore Case switch and Replace in Current Note / All Notes choices; the SDK text find model (controls textfind.rs) has the case and whole-word options.

features.apple: MainMenu: Edit > Spelling and Grammar, Substitutions, Transformations
features.note: Spelling and Grammar: Check Spelling While Typing marks misspelled words with a wavy rule (board.rs:347), Check Document Now selects the next one, Correct Spelling replaces the word at the caret, Learn and Ignore Spelling act on it, and Correct Spelling Automatically fixes a word when a space or punctuation follows it (spell.rs:57). Data Detectors are marked (see the links row). Substitutions: Smart Quotes and Smart Dashes (substitute.rs:23). Transformations: Make Upper Case, Make Lower Case, Capitalise. No grammar check, no Show Spelling and Grammar panel, no Text Replacement. Not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Grammar checking and the Show Spelling and Grammar panel need an SDK grammar service; Text Replacement needs the SDK text replacement table.

features.note: Edit > Speech > Start Speaking reads the selection, or the whole note, through the system speech engine (espeak-ng, else espeak) on a child process; Stop Speaking ends it, and quitting does too. Notifies when no engine is installed. No voice choice or highlight of the spoken word. Built on parity/team-d-stickies; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Route through an SDK speech service with audio output once one exists; add a voice choice.

features.note: Bold and Italic apply to the selection (or the whole note), per character (model.rs:302 Style, toggle_style main.rs:873). Bold is a heavier weight per run; Italic is drawn leaning (board.rs:261 slant) rather than with a true italic face.
features.wire: Use a real italic face once the renderer selects one per run.

features.note: Underline (Cmd+U), Strikethrough and Outline apply per selection (drawn in draw_body; Outline rings the letters, board.rs:229 draw_run). Built on the per-character styles of this round; not yet verified on Midget.

features.feature: Bigger / Smaller text and Show Fonts
features.apple: MainMenu: Font > Bigger, Smaller, Show Fonts
features.note: Bigger/Smaller (Cmd+= / Cmd+-) step the three sizes of the whole note; size is per note, not per run. No font family and no Show Fonts panel (the SDK font panel model has no per-run family drawing).
features.wire: Add a font family field to Style and a Show Fonts item using the SDK font panel once the renderer selects a face per run.

features.note: Kern and Ligature: Use Default, Use None, Use All per selection, set as font features (board.rs:100 features). Baseline: Use Default, Superscript, Subscript per selection, drawn shifted (model.rs:158 Baseline). Raise, Lower, Tighten and Loosen are not done.
features.wire: Raise and Lower move the baseline by points; Tighten and Loosen change tracking. Both need a point value on Style.

features.note: Font > Text Colour with five preset colours, per selection. No colour panel (the SDK ColorPanel model has no shell panel to open).
features.wire: Add a text colour attribute with a custom value and a Show Colours item using the SDK colour panel once it has a shell panel.

features.apple: MainMenu: Colour > Yellow, Blue, Green, Pink, Purple, Grey
features.note: Six colours; set differs (Orange/Teal instead of Blue/Grey).

Colour > Custom Colour... opens an in-app bar for a #RRGGBB value with a live swatch; Return applies it as one undo step. The colour is saved with the note (model.rs rgb field, JSON "rgb"), carried to new notes by Use as Default and checked in the menu. There is no hue wheel or slider panel: the SDK has no shell colour panel. Built on parity/team-d-stickies; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Add a hue wheel or slider panel using the SDK ColorPanel model (ui panels.rs hsb_to_rgb) once a shell colour panel exists; until then the hex bar is the entry.

features.feature: Use as Default (colour/font for new notes)
features.note: Font > Use as Default stores the focused note's colour and the style at its caret on the board (saved in the file); new notes take them. The caret style follows the per-character styles of this round.
features.wire: Store the default font family once a font family attribute exists.

features.note: Not done: the shell protocol has no window level message, so an app cannot ask for an always-on-top window. Notes share one window.
features.wire: Add a window level message to the shell protocol (proto) and the window manager; then make each note its own window or offer Float on Top for the board window, with a checked item.

features.note: Window > Translucent is a checked per-note toggle, saved in the file (model.rs translucent flag). draw_note uses it instead of a fixed rule (board.rs:195 see_through). Not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: MainMenu: Window > Collapse, Collapse All, Expand All; title-bar double-click
features.note: Collapse All, Expand All and a double press on the title bar (main.rs:471) added. Built on parity/team-d-stickies; not yet verified on Midget.

features.feature: Arrange By (colour, content, date, location) with undo
features.apple: MainMenu: Window > Arrange By; Localizable: Undo Arrange
features.note: Window > Arrange By Colour, Content, Date Created, Date Modified and Location sorts and lays the notes out in rows (model.rs arrange), undoable; Location reads the notes in rows from the top, left to right. Built on parity/team-d-stickies; not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Verify the five orders and the undo step on Midget.

features.feature: Zoom / Minimise / Bring All to Front
features.apple: MainMenu: Window > Zoom, Minimise, Bring All to Front
features.note: Window > Zoom Sticky Note toggles the focused note between its size and a large size (model.rs toggle_zoom). Minimise and Bring All to Front stay with the shell.
Drag title to move, grip to resize.

features.feature: Autosave and restore of all notes
features.note: Saved on every change, restored at launch; broken file moved aside. The file keeps one style per run of text (model.rs encode, "runs").
The focused note's created and modified dates (UTC, dates.rs) show as disabled rows in the Window menu; there is no hover tooltip input yet.
features.wire: Show a hover tooltip or a footer line with created/modified dates on the title bar via the SDK tooltip API.

features.apple: MainMenu: Edit > Add Link…, Substitutions > Smart Links, Data Detectors
features.note: Add Link... (Cmd+K) inserts a typed web address as text in place of the selection (one undo step; the note then underlines it). URLs (http, https, www.) are underlined (board.rs draw_body) and a double press or Edit > Open Link opens them. Data Detectors: Dates, Addresses and Phone Numbers are marked with a dotted rule when switched on (spell.rs marks, detect kinds from prefs.rs). No Cmd-click, no Smart Links substitution that turns typed text into a link.
features.wire: Cmd-click needs modifiers on touch input; Smart Links would convert typed addresses as they are typed.

features.feature: Make Sticky service (selection to new note)
features.note: The shell's Services menu routes Make New Sticky Note to a create-sticky intent, which the app declares (manifest.toml) and performs (main.rs:358 create_sticky): a note holding the text is added in front as one undo step, or written to the saved board when the app has not loaded it yet. Shift+Cmd+Y runs the service (hwkeys.rs MakeSticky, dispatched next to Look Up). Built on parity/team-d-stickies; the key is not yet verified on Midget.
features.wire: Check the Shift+Cmd+Y chord on Midget against the reference app's key.

features.feature: Rich text body with images (RTFD notes)
features.note: Not done: notes hold text with one style per character. Images and attachments need the rich note model (the SDK AttributedString and RichTextView types have a richer model than the note body).
features.wire: Long-term: store the note body as an AttributedString (SDK attributed.rs) with attachments; this also covers RTF export.

features.note: Apple help book content.
